design.text: Phase 3, multi-center, three-arm, randomized, open-label study comparing interferon alfa (IFN) alone, temsirolimus 25 mg alone, and the combination of temsirolimus 15 mg plus IFN.

citations.quote: The **primary efficacy endpoint** was **overall survival (OS)**. Overall survival was defined as the time between date of randomization and date of death, censored at the last date known alive.

target_moa.text: Temsirolimus is an inhibitor of mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin); it binds the intracellular protein FKBP-12, and the protein-drug complex inhibits mTOR activity controlling cell division, producing G1 growth arrest in treated tumor cells.

citations.quote: Temsirolimus is an inhibitor of mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin). Temsirolimus binds to an intracellular protein (FKBP-12), and the protein-drug complex inhibits the activity of mTOR that controls cell division. Inhibition of mTOR activity resulted in a G1 growth arrest in treated tumor cells.
Temsirolimus, an inhibitor of mTOR, is an antineoplastic agent.

modality.text: Small molecule (kinase/mTOR inhibitor) given as intravenous infusion.

citations.quote: TORISEL™ is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of advanced renal cell carcinoma. (1)

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=30%) are rash, asthenia, mucositis, nausea, edema, and anorexia. In the randomized trial (TORISEL n=208): rash 97 (47%), asthenia 104 (50%), mucositis 86 (41%), nausea 77 (37%), edema 73 (35%). Serious risks include hypersensitivity reactions, hyperglycemia, interstitial lung disease, bowel perforation, and acute renal failure.
